question_text: A 32-year-old Caucasian female is admitted to the emergency department with a 48-hour history of severe and diffuse abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and constipation. Her personal history is unremarkable except for an ectopic pregnancy 5 years ago. Upon admission, she is found to have a blood pressure of 120/60 mm Hg, a pulse of 105/min, a respiratory rate 20/min, and a body temperature of 37°C (98.6°F). She has diffuse abdominal tenderness, hypoactive bowel sounds, and mild distention on examination of her abdomen. Rectal and pelvic examination findings are normal. An abdominal plain film of the patient is given. What is the most likely cause of this patient’s condition?
